# [PR #2046] [Refactor] Remove obsolete RewriteWgmmaSync pass

## 正文

## Summary

- Remove the `RewriteWgmmaSync` transform pass, which is no longer needed.
- Delete `src/transform/wgmma_sync_rewriter.cc`, its Python wrapper in `tilelang/transform/__init__.py`, and the call site in `tilelang/engine/phase.py` (along with the now-unused `is_hopper` import).

## Test plan

- [ ] Build tilelang and confirm compilation succeeds without the removed source file.
- [ ] Run existing Hopper (sm90+) GEMM tests to ensure wgmma code generation still works correctly.
